description: This file implements the CosmosGrainStorage class for Orleans, enabling persistence of grain state using Azure Cosmos DB. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, initializes Cosmos DB resources, and handles retries and concurrency control via ETags.

classes.name: CosmosGrainStorage
classes.description: A class that implements Orleans grain storage using Azure Cosmos DB, providing methods for CRUD operations on grain state, resource initialization, and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the state of a grain from Cosmos DB.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes or updates the state of a grain in Cosmos DB, handling concurrency via ETags.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously clears or deletes the grain state from Cosmos DB.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle to initialize the storage provider.

methods.name: GetKeyString
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for a GrainId, sanitizing inputs.

methods.name: BuildPartitionKey
methods.description: Builds a partition key for a grain asynchronously using the partition key provider.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Cosmos DB client and creates necessary resources.

methods.name: InitializeCosmosClient
methods.description: Creates a CosmosClient instance using the configured options.

methods.name: TryCreateResources
methods.description: Creates Cosmos DB database and container resources with setup for indexing.

methods.name: TryDeleteDatabase
methods.description: Attempts to delete the Cosmos DB database, ignoring NotFound errors.

methods.name: ResetGrainState
methods.description: Resets the grain state to default, clearing ETag and existence flags.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of type T using the activator provider.
